guarded.EN: Say that again and see how far it gets you.
guarded.TL: Sabihin mo ulit at tingnan natin kung saan ka aabot.

guarded.EN: You want to push this? I will push back harder.
guarded.TL: Gusto mong isagad ito? Mas malakas akong gaganti.

guarded.EN: Don't make threats you can't survive.
guarded.TL: Huwag kang magbanta ng hindi mo kayang maligtasan.

guarded.EN: Try me. See what happens to you.
guarded.TL: Subukan mo ako. Tingnan mo kung anong mangyayari sa 'yo.

guarded.EN: You're digging your own grave with that talk.
guarded.TL: Hinuhukay mo ang sarili mong libingan sa salitang 'yan.

guarded.EN: Keep running that mouth and find out.
guarded.TL: Sige, magpatuloy ka sa kadadaldal at nang malaman mo.

guarded.EN: I'm not the one to mess with out here.
guarded.TL: Hindi ako ang taong dapat mong ginagalit dito.

guarded.EN: Push one more inch and we have bloodshed.
guarded.TL: Sumulong ka pa nang isang pulgada at magkakadugo.

guarded.EN: Say it one more time. I dare you.
guarded.TL: Ulitin mo pa nang isang beses. Hinahamon kita.
Pagsisisihan mo ang pagbangga sa akin.

neutral.EN: You're really testing me right now.
neutral.TL: Talagang sinusubok mo ang pasensya ko ngayon.

neutral.EN: Don't push your luck any further.
neutral.TL: Huwag mo nang isugal pa ang suwerte mo.

neutral.EN: You're out of line, and I won't stand for it.
neutral.TL: Sumusobra ka na, at hindi ako papayag diyan.

neutral.EN: You started this, but I'll finish it if I have to.
neutral.TL: Ikaw ang nagsimula, pero tatapusin ko kung kailangan.

neutral.EN: You're making a massive mistake talking to me like that.
neutral.TL: Napakalaking pagkakamali ang kausapin ako nang ganyan.

neutral.EN: Think very carefully about what you say next.
neutral.TL: Pag-isipan mong mabuti ang susunod mong sasabihin.

neutral.EN: I've had about enough of your disrespect.
neutral.TL: Sapat na ang pambabastos mo sa akin.

neutral.EN: You're crossing a boundary you can't walk back.
neutral.TL: Tumatawid ka sa hangganang hindi mo na mababawi.

neutral.EN: Back down before this escalates completely.
neutral.TL: Umatras ka bago pa tuluyang magkagulo.

neutral.EN: I'm answering in kind: knock it off.
neutral.TL: Sasagutin kita nang patas: itigil mo na 'yan.

warm.EN: I've been patient with you, but you're crossing the line.
warm.TL: Matiisin ako sa 'yo, pero lumalagpas ka na.

warm.EN: Don't make me treat you like a stranger.
warm.TL: Huwag mo akong piliting tratuhin ka na parang estranghero.

warm.EN: I didn't think you would turn on me like this.
warm.TL: Di ko akalaing kakalabanin mo ako nang ganito.

warm.EN: You're hurting someone who actually cared about you.
warm.TL: Sinasaktan mo ang taong may tunay na malasakit sa 'yo.

warm.EN: Stop pushing me away with this cruelty.
warm.TL: Tigilan mo ang pagtataboy sa akin gamit ang lupit na 'yan.

warm.EN: If you keep attacking me, I will protect myself.
warm.TL: Kung patuloy mo akong aatakihin, ipagtatanggol ko ang sarili ko.

warm.EN: You're throwing our bond away right in front of me.
warm.TL: Itinatapon mo ang samahan natin mismo sa harap ko.

warm.EN: I expected better from you. Don't push me further.
warm.TL: Umasa ako ng mas maayos sa 'yo. Huwag mo na akong itulak.

warm.EN: Check yourself. I won't just stand here and take abuse.
warm.TL: Ayusin mo sarili mo. Di ako tatayo lang dito para magpaabuso.
